infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NUX uses the camera only to scan QR codes at partner restaurants so you can view the menu, collect loyalty points, pay at your table, and redeem gift vouchers. For example, point your camera at the QR code on your table to open the menu or complete a payment. Photos and videos are not stored.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: NUX accesses your photo library only so you can choose an existing image that contains a gift voucher QR code and redeem it. For example, select a screenshot of a voucher QR code from your gallery. We do not upload or store your photos.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: NUX uses Face ID to confirm it is you when approving a wallet payment or a gift voucher transfer. For example, authenticate with Face ID before sending a voucher to another user.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NUX uses your location while the app is open to find nearby restaurants and to verify you are at a partner restaurant when scanning a QR code to earn loyalty points or pay. For example, we show restaurants near you on the Explore map and confirm you are on-site when you scan a table QR code.
